description_for_human: Tests in GitLab CI, docs as merge requests, branches, issues and log analysis.
description_for_model: Tools for software development work in the company's GitLab: read merge requests and code, run AI-written unit tests in GitLab CI and open merge requests only when they pass, propose documentation as merge requests, create branches, comments and issues, explain red pipelines and count errors in application logs. It never merges, deploys or deletes.

functions.name: listProjects
functions.description: List the GitLab projects DevAssist may use.

functions.name: listMergeRequests
functions.description: List merge requests of a project; assignedToMe=true for the signed-in user's merge requests.

functions.name: getMergeRequestChanges
functions.description: Read a merge request's diff, changed source files, an example test and the testing rules. Call before writing tests for a merge request.

functions.name: listFiles
functions.description: List file paths in a branch, optionally filtered by text in the path.

functions.name: getFileContent
functions.description: Read one file from a branch.

functions.name: getPipelineStatus
functions.description: Get the status of one CI pipeline.

functions.name: getPipelineFailure
functions.description: For a red pipeline, get the failed job and the masked end of its log.

functions.name: searchIncidentLogs
functions.description: Count and group errors in the application logs for the time range in the question, with masked samples and deployments in that window.

functions.name: getTestRun
functions.description: Check a test run started with startTestRun: status, pipeline result, counts, coverage, failure log or merge request.

instructions: Only report numbers present in the response (tests_added, tests_passed, tests_failed, coverage_before, coverage_after). Never invent them.
Include merge_request_url and pipeline_url as links when present.

functions.name: createBranch
functions.description: Create a branch from an existing branch.

confirmation.title: Create branch
confirmation.body: DevAssist will create a new branch in GitLab. Continue?

functions.name: commentOnMergeRequest
functions.description: Add a comment to a merge request.

confirmation.title: Comment on merge request
confirmation.body: DevAssist will post a comment on the merge request in GitLab. Continue?

confirmation.title: Create issue
confirmation.body: DevAssist will create an issue in GitLab. Continue?

functions.name: startTestRun
functions.description: Commit an AI-written test file to a new ai/tests-* branch and run it in GitLab CI. Returns at once with a run_id; CI takes minutes.

confirmation.title: Run tests in GitLab CI
confirmation.body: DevAssist will commit the test file to a new ai/tests-* branch and run the CI pipeline. A merge request is opened only if it passes. Continue?

instructions: Tell the user the tests were committed and CI is running, with the branch and run_id.
Do not claim any result yet. Offer to check the result later with getTestRun.

functions.name: retryTestRun
functions.description: Commit a corrected test file to the run's branch and run CI again.

confirmation.title: Run corrected tests
confirmation.body: Commit the corrected test file and run the pipeline again?

functions.name: reportBugInCode
functions.description: Close a failed test run without a merge request because the code under test is wrong.

confirmation.title: Report bug
confirmation.body: Close this test run and report the bug instead of opening a merge request?

functions.name: proposeApiReference
functions.description: Open a merge request that writes docs/api.md and links it from the README.

confirmation.title: Open documentation MR
confirmation.body: DevAssist will open a merge request that adds docs/api.md. Continue?

functions.name: proposeChangelog
functions.description: Open a merge request that updates CHANGELOG.md from merged merge requests.

confirmation.title: Open changelog MR
confirmation.body: DevAssist will open a merge request that updates CHANGELOG.md. Continue?

functions.name: proposeCodeComments
functions.description: Open a merge request that adds docstrings to one Python file. Rejected if code changes.

confirmation.title: Open code comments MR
confirmation.body: DevAssist will open a merge request that adds docstrings to the file. Continue?
